headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2026, back when Callum Newman vs. Francesco Akira vs. HENARE vs. Will Ospreay vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Daniel Garcia vs. Jon Moxley vs. PAC settled things in a Chaos In Canada match, serving as the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 8.04 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. In a "Chaos in Canada" Anything Goes brawl, Will Ospreay's United Empire ? himself, Callum Newman, HENARE and Francisco Akira ? overran Moxley's Death Riders trio of Castagnoli, PAC and Garcia.

On a Friday in 2022, back when Jon Moxley vs. Wheeler Yuta headlined Rampage, rated 9.12 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype. A star-making performance from Yuta ? bloodied and battered, he kicked out of two Paradigm Shifts and earned real respect from William Regal afterward, a defeat that ultimately launched him into the Blackpool Combat Club.
